name: Foiling catamaran
notes: Origin at the centre between the hulls at the waterline, bow +Z, up +Y, hulls at x = +-3.6. Joints foil 0...1 (hulls lift 2 m, foil blades stay in the water), heel -1...1 (roll 15 deg), wing -1...1 (wing yaw 30 deg plus flap 15 deg), rudder -1...1 (rudder yaw 20 deg) are empty drivers; parts mimic them.
parts: two lofted white hulls with graphite rubbing strakes and deck pads
graphite trampoline net with lacing on two carbon crossbeams and a bow pole
24 m two-element rigid wing sail with trailing flap on a mast step
style: Sponsor-free white and graphite racing catamaran, clearcoat paint, carbon foils, original shapes only.
summary: 15 m foiling racing catamaran: lofted white hulls, trampoline net, carbon crossbeams, crew pods, two-element rigid wing sail, L-foils and T-rudders.
